description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Fruit & Flower is a high-fiber, low-protein, calcium-rich pellet food for tortoises. Composition: oats, maize, oat bran, lucerne, beet pulp, calcium carbonate, dicalcium phosphate, turmeric and spirulina, with banana and freshly mown grass aromas. Vitamins A, D3 and E are added, along with iron, copper, zinc, manganese, iodine and selenium. The small jar is a good choice for one tortoise or for checking whether it likes the taste. A large jar is also available for regular feeding.

This is a complementary food, not a replacement for fresh greens. The manufacturer recommends feeding it a couple of times a week as part of a varied diet, at 1-4% of the tortoise's body weight. Soak the pellets in warm water before feeding to soften them. Store in a cool, dark place.
It suits European, Russian and most other tortoise species. Learn how to set up a home for your tortoise in our tortoise terrarium guide.

All equipment can be ordered by phone or WhatsApp message. Courier delivery across Serbia, in-person pickup in Novi Sad. For questions about the product, compatibility or recommendations for your animal - get in touch.
